task_name: Collect Factory Materials, Start Hammer Production in Hardware Store, and Re-queue Wood

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: When Wood and Metal finish at the factories and the Hardware Store is idle.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: Hammers take 14 minutes to craft and require 1 Metal and 1 Wood; starting Hammer production early ensures Hammers are ready when residential buildings request them.
preconditions: At least 1 Metal and 1 Wood collected from factories
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Collect Wood and Metal from the northern factories, drag the Hammer recipe into the Hardware Store, and refill the factories with Wood.

steps.who: floating Wood and Metal on the northern Small Factories

steps.briefing: open the Hardware Store crafting interface.
drag the Hammer recipe into the production slot.
drag Wood logs into the empty production slots.
